# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_docs.py from the argparse parsers. Do not edit. -->

`nexus-mcp-ci` with no arguments starts the MCP server over stdio. `python -m nexus_mcp` does the same.

## nexus-mcp-ci eval

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci eval [-h] [--example] [--questions QUESTIONS] [--seed SEED] [--keep-index]
                         [--out OUT] [--json] [--agent SPECS] [--preset {efficient,matrix,quick}]
                         [--conditions CONDITIONS] [--tasks TASKS] [--max-usd MAX_USD]
                         [--concurrency CONCURRENCY] [--yes]
                         [source]

Measure Nexus-MCP against Grep and Read on questions made from your own code. Free, offline, no
LLM. Nothing leaves your machine.

positional arguments:
  source                A folder (default: current folder) or a public https:// repo URL, or
                        `list` / `show <id>` / `share <id>` / `doctor`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --example             Use the Nexus-MCP source code as the example project (offline)
  --questions QUESTIONS
                        Number of questions (default 30)
  --seed SEED           Seed for the question sample (default 7)
  --keep-index          Keep the index in <project>/.nexus so adopting Nexus-MCP needs no re-index
  --out OUT             Also copy report.md and report.json here
  --json                Print the result as JSON

agent tier (paid, opt-in):
  A real A/B run of Claude Code or Codex with and without Nexus-MCP. It sends prompts and the
  code the agent reads to the provider, through your own CLI and login.

  --agent SPECS         runner[:model] list, for example claude, claude:haiku,claude:sonnet or
                        codex:gpt-5-codex (Codex is experimental)
  --preset {efficient,matrix,quick}
                        quick: claude:sonnet, 4 tasks. matrix: every --agent model. efficient:
                        also the mcp condition, then the cheapest setup at the same accuracy
  --conditions CONDITIONS
                        Comma list of baseline, mcp, nexus (default: baseline,nexus)
  --tasks TASKS         Tasks per condition (default 4)
  --max-usd MAX_USD     Stop starting runs at this spend (default 5)
  --concurrency CONCURRENCY
                        Parallel runs (default 3)
  --yes                 Skip the question before a paid run or a share

Saved runs: `eval list`, `eval show <id>`. Your data: `nexus-mcp-ci data where`.
```

## nexus-mcp-ci setup

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci setup [-h]
                          [--client {claude-code,claude-desktop,cursor,vscode,windsurf,gemini,codex,cline}]
                          [--yes] [--dry-run] [--uninstall] [--no-skill] [--no-index]
                          [--project PROJECT]

Add the Nexus-MCP server and its skill to your MCP client. Shows each change first. Writes nothing
until you say yes (or pass --yes).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --client {claude-code,claude-desktop,cursor,vscode,windsurf,gemini,codex,cline}
                        Client to set up (repeat for more). Default: every client found on this
                        machine
  --yes                 Do not ask; make the shown changes
  --dry-run             Show the changes and write nothing
  --uninstall           Remove what setup wrote
  --no-skill            Add the server only, not the skill text
  --no-index            Do not start an index of this folder
  --project PROJECT     Project folder for project-level files (default: .)
```

## nexus-mcp-ci license

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci license [-h] {activate,status,deactivate} ...

Commercial licence key. Free for noncommercial use; commercial use needs a paid key
(https://github.com/jaggernaut007/Nexus-MCP#pricing). Nothing is ever blocked.

positional arguments:
  {activate,status,deactivate}
    activate            Activate a key on this machine and save it
    status              Show the licence state (checks the server if a key is set)
    deactivate          Free this machine's activation and delete the saved key

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

With no key, Nexus-MCP makes no network call.
```

## nexus-mcp-ci data

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci data [-h] {where,clear,export-memories} ...

Show, export and delete the data that Nexus-MCP stores on this machine.

positional arguments:
  {where,clear,export-memories}
    where               List every place data is kept, with sizes
    clear               Delete stored data (dry run unless --yes)
    export-memories     Write memories to a JSON file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

### nexus-mcp-ci data where

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci data where [-h] [path]

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

### nexus-mcp-ci data clear

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci data clear [-h] [--index] [--memories] [--graph] [--evals] [--clones]
                               [--models] [--all] [--yes]
                               [path]

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --index     Delete the index
  --memories  Delete the memories
  --graph     Delete the graph
  --evals     Delete the evals
  --clones    Delete the clones
  --models    Delete the models
  --all       All of the above
  --yes       Really delete (the default is a dry run)
```

### nexus-mcp-ci data export-memories

```text
usage: nexus-mcp-ci data export-memories [-h] [--out OUT] [path]

positional arguments:
  path

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --out OUT
```
